description: Folder tree of the user's World Codex (omit campaign_id) or a campaign workspace (campaign_id set). Returns structure and per-folder item_count only - call chargen_get_collection for one folder's items. Workspace trees include codex folders the campaign references (from_codex true; grafted roots carry ref_row_id).

campaign_id.description: Campaign UUID for that campaign's workspace tree; omit for the World Codex
